rationale: Saudi pipeline closure affects EU energy indirectly; Houthi Red Sea advance continues threatening Black Sea shipping connections.

top_events.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
top_events.label: Saudi pipeline shut after Iraq drone strike
top_events.summary: Saudi Arabia closed a major oil pipeline following a drone attack from Iraq near Iran. Iraq removed a military commander and opened investigations.

top_events.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
top_events.label: Houthis seize strategic island near Red Sea
top_events.summary: Iran-backed Houthis reportedly seized Perim island on a major shipping route, tightening control over Red Sea lanes affecting Black Sea trade connections.

top_events.title: Passenger train derails in France leaving at least 44 injured
top_events.label: French train derails injuring 44 passengers
top_events.summary: A passenger train in Normandy derailed with 180 passengers on board, injuring at least 44 people in western EU.

short_summary: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening Red Sea route

most_significant_event.label: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening Red Sea route
most_significant_event.summary: Mokha capture brings Houthis closer to controlling Bab al-Mandab Strait, a key waterway for Black Sea region trade and energy logistics affecting Romania.
